messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "interval of at least 8 hours between doses"
set: ["interval of at least 8 hours between doses", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "sustained-release oral tablets should be given at least 8 hours apart", "8 tablets/24 hours", "leave no more than 12 hours between doses", "change day of the week as long as at least three days between doses", "time between two doses must be at least 2 days (>48 hours)", "time between the 2 doses must be at least 3 days (72 hours)", "7 to 8 hours", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "take at least 2 hours after an antacid", "subsequent doses given 4 and 8 hours after first dose", "adrenal glands recovery between doses", "prolonged QT interval", "do not take extra doses between scheduled doses", "subsequent parenteral doses given 4 and 8 hours after first dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
